steps.title: Look at forcing moves first
steps.body: Before choosing a quiet move, list every check, capture and threat, for you and for them. Forcing moves limit what the opponent can do, so you can calculate them.

steps.q: Which should you look at first?
steps.why: Forcing moves are easiest to calculate.

steps.q: You can capture a pawn. What should you do before taking?
options: Count what they can take back
steps.why: A capture can lose to a recapture or a trap.

cards.prompt: What are the three forcing ideas?
cards.why: Look at them for both sides.
